why: Effects (the fourth kind's type 0) name no object that spawned them; those of the effect ids the family's code spawns are the family's, compared as such: its muzzle's blast (BN5's 0x57, BN6's 0x6C: BN5 0x08108FB6) and its reticle's strike (0x0E: BN5 0x080C9660-0x080C9662); a Navi's, its own (effect, navis: 0xA0 on).
